reviewScope: Internal engineering/model-consistency and browser viewport review,not independent expert,official-board,manufacturer accuracy,external calibration or physical-device certification. Two separate equal aliquots at prescribed1mL/s from a finite source; lumped model omits jet/wall-film inventory,splashing,drainage and evaporation. Prescribed volume-compensated parabolic menisci,not a contact-angle solver. Readings available at flow stop without a hydrodynamic settling delay. Chosen common scale bias and exercise reporting conventions; half-increment bounds describe rounding only,not total uncertainty or confidence intervals. No parallax or temperature expansion. Deterministic repeated reads are not a statistical precision study. Pointer orbit,FPS and physical printing not certified.
